Name: uv
OneLiner: Fast project, environment and dependency manager.
NotIdealFor: Projects that must stay on a legacy toolchain
TokenTips: Use `uv run` instead of activating environments by hand

Name: Ruff
OneLiner: Linter and formatter in one, very fast.
TokenTips: Enable the rule sets you need rather than everything

Name: pytest
OneLiner: Test runner with fixtures and plugins.
TokenTips: Use fixtures for setup, not inheritance

Name: FastAPI
BestFor: JSON APIs with validation and docs
NotIdealFor: Server-rendered sites with admin screens (consider Django)

Name: Jupyter
OneLiner: Interactive notebooks mixing code, output and text.
TokenTips: Move reusable code out of the notebook into modules
Restart and run all before sharing

Name: mypy / pyright
OneLiner: Static type checkers that read your hints.
TokenTips: Adopt gradually: start strict on new modules
